DONE

The loading state is wired up, but it won't be visible in practice. `CatalogViewModel.init` calls `runBlocking { repo.load() }`, so loading finishes before the screen first composes and `isLoading` is already `false` when the spinner would appear. Making the spinner actually show needs the load moved off the main thread (P07), which is outside this fix.

Changes:
- `CatalogViewModel.kt`: added `isLoading` (public getter, private setter), starting `true` and set to `false` after the load in `init`.
- `CatalogScreen.kt`: while `vm.isLoading` is true, shows a centered `CircularProgressIndicator` instead of the stats, recent row and list. The `pulse` animation was moved above the branch so it is still created unconditionally.

I did not build or run this.
